annotations.title: Resolve a NSW street address to its official form and coordinates, free.

description: Resolve a NSW street address to its official form and coordinates, free. Matches the address against the official NSW address register (Spatial Services). Use it to check an address before a paid nearby search, or to get latitude/longitude. Ambiguous input returns suggestions. Free, no payment needed. Source: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure (NSW Planning Portal), CC BY 4.0.
